description: Returns what you need to write or repair a plan that the checks can read: links to the JSON Schemas, the shortest valid plan, a worked example of a two-person scene that the checks find nothing wrong with, and a summary of the details that switch each check on (which is why a thin plan comes back "not assessed"). Call it first if you are about to write a plan. Input: none. Output: {schemas, smallest_plan, example_plan, details_that_make_checks_work, rules_of_thumb, rules_version}. No AI model runs; it needs no plan and stores nothing. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).
name: shoot_plan_format
title: How to write a plan the checks can read
